title: When AI Benchmarks Plateau: A Systematic Study of Benchmark Saturation
authors: Mubashara Akhtar, Anka Reuel, et al. (EvalEval Coalition; 37 authors)
used_for: 61 developer reports / 190 benchmarks; report frequency not associated with saturation (rho=0.05,p=0.73); age and test-set size predict saturation

'61 documents ... 190 benchmarks', Jan 2022-Nov 2025, >=5-report filter, rho=0.05/p=0.73, age + test-set size, private test sets (N=4) no effect all confirmed. arXiv:2602.16763 confirmed via the evaleval/benchmark-saturation GitHub README (arxiv.org itself unreachable).
